attchmntText: Orchid Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Orchid Pharma Limited filed a statement of deviation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the use of Rs 400 Crores raised through Qualified Institutional Placement on June 27, 2023. The company modified the allocation of proceeds with shareholder approval obtained at the AGM on September 20, 2025. Funds originally allocated to the API Facility in Alathur were reallocated to the Jammu Manufacturing Facility and repayment of borrowings. The Jammu facility faces significant delays due to land acquisition issues, with commercial operations now expected by February 2027. The Alathur project has been postponed. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement. Care Ratings Limited acts as the monitoring agency.

attchmntText: Orchid Pharma Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Orchid Pharma Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Standalone net sales for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, were 34,126.66 lakhs. Standalone profit for the period was 3,675.93 lakhs. Earnings per share was 6.14 rupees. Consolidated net sales for the quarter were 34,126.66 lakhs. Consolidated profit for the period was 2,859.41 lakhs. Consolidated earnings per share was 4.77 rupees. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 2,36,691.01 lakhs on a standalone basis. Consolidated total assets were 2,65,235.42 lakhs. The results include auditors' limited review reports from M/s. Singhi & Co.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for Quarter-II ended on September 30,2026
voiceSummary: Orchid Pharma Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Quarter-II ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited regarding the Qualified Institutional Placement. The company revised the allocation of proceeds from Rs. 400 crores based on shareholder approval obtained via AGM resolution dated September 20, 2025. Funds were reallocated to increase investment in Orchid Bio Pharma Limited for a Jammu manufacturing facility and repayment of borrowings, while allocation for the Alathur API facility was reduced. The Jammu facility faces significant delays, with commercial operations expected by February 2027. All QIP proceeds totaling Rs. 394.54 crores were fully utilized by the end of the quarter. No deviation from the objects was reported.

attchmntText: Orchid Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Orchid Pharma Limited has intimated that an Analysts Investors Earning Call is scheduled for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 4:30 P.M. IST. The call, hosted by Systematix Institutional Equities, will discuss the financial performance and results for the Quarter-II and half year ended on September 30, 2026. This intimation is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations and SEBI Master Circular dated January 30, 2026. The information will also be available on the company website at www.orchidpharma.com. The schedule may change due to exigencies. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Kapil Dayya on November 12, 2026.
